lead.note: **13359 Korn's (NY)**: "39 acres of wooded land on the Shawangunk Kill River"; entry not waterfront.
lead.prior_evidence: Esri z17 satellite: the RV area is an open field and loop on the hill east of the Shawangunk Kill; the river runs in a wooded ravine roughly 250 m west - not waterfront --Claude

lead.note: **14339 Niagara Shores (NY)**: lakeview RV sites "Most ... currently located waters edge with panoramic views of Lake Ontario"; entry lakeview.
lead.prior_evidence: satellite (Esri, 600 m frame) at 43.3429,-78.6802 (Google's place; the Good Sam pin was 27 km off): loops of sites north of the lodge reach the Lake Ontario bluff, with a band of trees along the bank between the nearest pads and the water - lakeview, matching the operator's 'Lakeview' site names (default down)

lead.note: **14320 Pine Ridge (NY)**: sells "Deluxe Waterfront" and "Waterfront - No Hookups" sites on the river through the park; entry riverview.
lead.prior_evidence: satellite (Esri, 440 m frame) at 44.9416,-74.3785: campground clearing inside a bend of the river with open meadow running down to the bank on both sides, but no pads visible at the water in the imagery; the operator's 'waters edge' sites can't be confirmed - riverview (default down)

lead.note: **13728 Luzerne (NY)** (weak): RA "partially surrounds Fourth Lake"; entry not waterfront.
lead.prior_evidence: DEC campground map (luzernemap.pdf): camping loops sit east of and set back from Fourth Lake through forest, day-use beach on the lake; satellite at 43.3535,-73.8189 is canopy -> not waterfront

lead.note: **13727 Rogers Rock (NY)** (weak): west shore of Lake George with a sand beach; entry not waterfront.
lead.prior_evidence: DEC campground map (rogersrock23.pdf): shoreline sites (1-17, 50-75, 244-258) sit inside the campground road that runs along the Lake George shore with the mooring strip beyond; canopy at 43.7943,-73.4856 hides any view; RA carries no shoreline flag -> default down, not waterfront
